answer.origin: Media report on finance.yahoo.com (published 2026-07-01) of NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement; the original company release date is not stated in the supplied records.
answer.note: NN, Inc. announced in late June 2026 that it will add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. NN states that 100% of the new capacity is already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and targets US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026. For NVIDIA, this is a supplier-side lead: it suggests that liquid-cooling capacity for NVIDIA-related rack programs is being contracted in Asia during 2026. It does not show that NVIDIA is the buyer, or the size of any NVIDIA order, and the awarding customers are not identified in the supplied records. The NN revenue and earnings projections and the Russell index removal concern NN and are not evidence about NVIDIA.
limitations: The awarding customers for the pre-sold capacity are not identified, so it is not established that NVIDIA directly buys this capacity or that the awards are NVIDIA orders.
The 100% pre-sold status and the US$80-90 million 2026 target are company statements relayed by a media outlet; they are not independently verified and no timing of revenue recognition is given.
The supplied records give no NVIDIA-side confirmation of a supply relationship with NN or of NVIDIA rack volumes that would require this capacity.

The NN narrative projections (US$485.5 million revenue, US$47.9 million earnings by 2028) and the unnamed analyst estimates are about NN, not NVIDIA, and are unverified third-party or rumour-tier material.
The original announcement date within late June 2026 is not stated.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original late-June 2026 press release or SEC filing to confirm the 47 machine centers, the pre-sold claim, and whether the awards name any customer or NVIDIA.
Check NVIDIA's latest 10-K and supplier disclosures for liquid cooling or rack thermal suppliers, including any named NN relationship or purchase commitments.
Check NVIDIA rack or reference-design announcements and partner releases for liquid cooling supply in Asia during 2026 to see whether this capacity is tied to NVIDIA programs.
